title: Zesty Simmered Mexican Pork Cochinita Pibil
description: A fermented, cheese-pull, brunch-mood Mexican dish featuring parmesan cheese, simmer, high-protein-friendly, form=cochinita-pibil.
instructions: In a blender, combine orange juice, lime juice, olive oil, garlic, onion, cumin, and paprika, and blend until smooth.
Place the pork shoulder in a large Dutch oven and pour the blender mixture over the top.
Cover the Dutch oven with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Braise the pork for 6 hours, or until tender and easily shredded.
Remove the pork from the oven and shred with two forks.
Stir in the parmesan cheese until melted and well combined.
Serve the cochinita pibil hot, garnished with additional parmesan cheese if desired.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
